finding.title: OS Command Injection

parsed.refutation_attempt: The reported sink is a call to strdup, which merely allocates memory and copies the provided string. It does not invoke any shell or system command, nor does it pass the string to a function that interprets it as a command. Therefore, no OS command injection can occur from these lines. The untrusted data is safely stored in memory and later printed, but no execution context is involved.
